arabic text: MEI KHAWAB ME ASGAR TUJE\nLORI BHI SUNAAWUN
english translation text: EVEN IN MY DREAMS\nI WILL SING YOU LULLABIES

arabic text: LOWT AWO SAFAR SE KE BARI DEYR HUWI HAI\nBETAB HUN KAB SE TUJE\nSINE SE LAGAWOON
english translation text: COME BACK FROM YOUR JOURNEY AS ITS\nBEEN TOO LONG, I AM WAITING\nTO HOLD YOU CLOSE TO MY CHEST

arabic text: KOYI MUJE BATLAA TA NAHI TERI NISHANI\nBARSAAT ME TEERON KI\nKAHAN DHOOND NE JAWOON
english translation text: NOBODY IS TELLING ME OF WHERE\nYOU ARE, HOW SHALL I FIND\nYOU IN THE RAIN OF ARROWS

arabic text: SOCHAA THA TERI SAAL GHIRA GHAR ME KAROONGI\nTAQDIR YE KEHTI HAI\nTERAA SOG MANAWOO
english translation text: I WAS HOPING THAT YOU WILL\nBE WITH ME AT YOUR BIRTHDAY,\nBUT NOW I HAVE TO MOURN YOU

arabic text: BABAA SE TERE TERAA JANAZA NAA UTHEGAA\nRUKH JAA ZARAA ABBAS KO\nDARYAA SE BULAAWOO
english translation text: IT WILL NOT BE EASY FOR YOUR\nFATHER TO CARRY YOUR BODY, WAIT A WHILE\nLET ME CALL ABBAS FROM THE RIVER

arabic text: YE KHOON BHARAA KURTAA YE MATI ME BHARE BAAL\nSINE ME CHUPAWOON KE\nMEI AANKHON SE LAGAWOON
english translation text: YOUR CLOTHES ARE DRENCHED IN BLOOD AND YOUR HAIR\nARE FILLED WITH DUST, SHALL I HIDE YOU\nIN MY CHEST OR HUG YOU WITH MY EYES

arabic text: IS TARHAA KOYI RUTH KE MAA SE NAHI JATAA\nTU KHUD HI BATAA DE MEI\nTUJE KAISE MANAWOO
english translation text: YOU CAN’T GO AWAY FROM\nYOUR MOTHER ANGRY TELL ME YOURSELF\nHOW SHALL I PAMPER YOU
